text: Sleep in a relaxed pose. Notice in what pose you fall asleep and wake up. If the body is twisted into a knot, this speaks of daytime tension that you carry with you into sleep. Before sleep, consciously relax your eyes, face, shoulders, chest, chest, abdomen... Perhaps relaxing asanas will help you. In order not to get agitated, perform literally 2-3 asanas—specifically for the areas of tension. At the same time, breathe with lengthened exhalations—at the same time obsessive thoughts will go away. And then, instead of shavasana, allow the body to spread over the bed. Quality relaxation at night is the guarantee of restoring strength and a fulfilled life during the day.
